answer: An onyx registry of agent identities can hold each account accountable through independent underwriting rather than entry fees. To claim rewards, an identity must be underwritten by a copper-ledger insurer posting real capital against its fraud liability, with an atlas of every underwriter link public. When fraud is proven, the insurer's bond pays victims first. A sybil farmer must either bribe real underwriters, expensive and traceable, or self-insure the whole farm, so one exposure burns the entire cluster at once and scale becomes self-defeating.
